data.title: Appointment confirmation: vehicle re-registration (Umschreibung Fahrzeug)
data.summary: The Kreis Beispielförde vehicle registration office (Zulassungsstelle) confirms a Saturday-service appointment on 7 March 2026 at 10:00 for re-registering (Umschreibung) a vehicle, counter 2, with an approximate fee of €37.60.
data.explanation: This letter confirms a booked appointment to re-register your vehicle at the local registration office. Bring the listed documents (vehicle registration certificate parts I and II, your insurance's eVB number, a SEPA mandate for the vehicle tax, and your ID card) and be prepared to pay the fee of about €37.60 on site. If you cannot attend or are missing documents, contact the office using the phone number or email given to reschedule, since the office likely cannot process the re-registration without them.
